info.name: Get a presigned URL to share a file in a channel.

items.docs: Get a presigned URL to share a file in a channel. Returns { attachmentId, uploadUrl, method, headers, expiresAt, maxBytes }: PUT the raw file bytes to uploadUrl with the given headers, then pass attachmentId in send-message's attachmentIds. You must be a member of the channel.

info.name: Get a presigned URL to download a file shared in a channel.

items.docs: Get a presigned URL to download a file shared in a channel. Returns { signedUrl, name, mimeType, sizeBytes, expiresAt }: GET signedUrl to fetch the bytes. You must be a member of the channel the file belongs to.
